_help: World map window in 1366x768 space. wx,wy,ww,wh is the window; worldX/worldY the map art inside it (the picture's own top left corner, 640x470); titleH is the title strip height. The left column: infoX/infoY is the header box (168x59, the map name goes here), infoBodyY the body box under it (168x344); nameX/nameY/nameW the map name inside the header; lifeX/lifeY/lifeStep/lifeRows the NPC and monster rows (the official lifeLT is 16,145 with a 20 px pitch), lifeW/lifeTextX the row width and its text column; teleportX/teleportY and naviStartX/naviStartY the two disabled buttons under the list. The toolbar: btnY, btnW/btnH, upperX/locateX/searchX/bookmarkX/naviX are the five buttons on the title strip (the art is 37x25). The top strip: comboX/comboY/comboW/comboPitch place the three combo boxes. A map node's click box is its icon size, so it has no key here. The search panel hangs on the right edge: searchW/searchH, then sInX/sInY/sInW/sInH the name field (the type combo below it is as wide and starts at the same left edge), goInset/goSize the search button inside the field's right end, sTypeY its combo, sCloseX/sCloseY its X, and sListX/sListY/sRowW/sRowH/sRows the result rows (sTextX is their text column). The confirm dialog: confirmW/confirmH (the sysPop art is 318 wide), popBottomH the bottom bar, popTextY/popTextStep the two lines, popYesX/popNoX/popBtnY and popBtnW/popBtnH the two buttons. wcloseX/wcloseY the window X. tipPad/tipRowH/tipW = the tooltip box padding, one row of its list and the widest picture or map name of a left column row (a longer name is cut). tipGap = the space around the grey rule, tipArtGap = the space under the picture, tipBullet = the icon column of a node row (its text uses the Text component). comboRowH = the height of a combo box and of one row of its open list (the art is 20 tall, so this cannot change); comboTextX/comboTextPad = where the text of a combo starts and how much room it leaves at its right end, comboArrowW/comboEndW = the width of that end (the arrow cap of a closed box, the mirrored left cap of a list row). lifeW = the hover width of a left column row (the row art is 146 wide, the name drawn on it reaches 152). caretDx/caretW/caretH = the caret of the search field; it is vertically centred in the field. The minimap window has its own file (panel-minimap.json).
